_comment: What the cars' parts say: a race's damage report (condition.*), the repair shop's jobs (repair.job.*), why a part
will not come off or go on (work.*). {corner} is a corner as condition.corner.* says it (condition.axle.* an axle, for the station's hints), {zone} a body zone as
condition.zone.*; {peak} the hottest the water got, {litres} fuel left, {kmh} a hit, {before}, {after}, {left}
and {life} percentages ({rust} and {paint} too: repair.job.rust and .paint), {cause} condition.cause.*, {part} a part as condition.failed.* or condition.damaged.* says it
(repair.job.engine.*: the part's name). work.*.one is said of a kind whose name is one thing ("the radiator"),
.other of one whose name is many ("the cylinder heads"); {kind} is the kind's name, {parts} a list made with
work.the, work.list and work.list.comma ("the oil pan, the timing cover and the cylinder heads").
station.job.*: the gas station's jobs; {left} and {tank} the fuel, {quarts} the oil short as station.oil_short.* says it
("a quart"; the game puts a capital on the first letter of the oil job's detail). parts.describe*: a part's
condition ({wear} %) and how many parts come with it ({count}). part_group.*: the shelves of part_groups.json, by id.
part_show.*: the parts view's buttons of part_groups.json's shows, by id. layout.*: where a car carries its engine,
by the layout's name in cars.json; layout.guessed: the Car Catalog Editor's guess, {layout} a layout.* line.
rebuild.*: the jobs of parts/rebuilds.json, by id; rebuild.why.*: why a job cannot be done on a part now.

lines.condition.problem.totaled: the body is wrecked: the car is totaled
lines.condition.problem.fuel_low: there's hardly any fuel in the tank
lines.condition.oil.light: the oil light flickers at idle. It needs oil before it runs dry.
lines.condition.oil.burning: it's burning oil. Have the level checked at the gas station.
lines.condition.engine.overheated: Engine: it overheated ({peak:temp}) and cooked some of its life away. A bigger radiator would keep it cool.
lines.condition.engine.hot: Engine: it ran hot ({peak:temp}) and went flat at the top. A bigger radiator would keep it cool.
lines.condition.engine.oil_surged: Engine: the oil surged off the pickup and the bearings ran dry. A deeper oil pan would hold it.
lines.condition.fuel.dry: the tank is dry. Fill it up before the next race.
lines.condition.fuel.too_little: {litres:fuel:0.0} left, too little to race on. Fill it up.
lines.condition.body.totaled: The body is wrecked: the car is totaled.
lines.condition.engine.cooked_blown: Engine: {cause} finished it. It needs a rebuild before it runs again.
lines.condition.engine.cooked_worn: Engine: {cause} wore the whole bottom end ({before:0}% → {after:0}%).
lines.condition.engine.let_go: Engine: {part} let go. It needs a rebuild before it runs again.
lines.condition.engine.blew: Engine: it blew. It needs a rebuild before it runs again.
